title: Greer's CE5 coherent thought sequencing

tellings.quote: According to Greer, the craft picks up on a directed coherent thought signal as clearly as a radio would pick up on an electromagnetic signal.

plain: According to Steven Greer, a doctor who leads groups trying to make contact with UFOs through a meditation practice he calls CE5, short for "close encounters of the fifth kind", a craft can pick up a focused, coherent thought as clearly as a radio picks up a radio signal. Michels lays out Greer's idea himself, as the theory behind why such group meditation might draw craft in.
